description:
## Goal

Store scheduler work-start counts in the existing fixed-field `WorkStartTally` representation and delete per-enqueue hash-map accounting.

## Evidence

The scheduler has a closed `WorkStartReason` enum but stores six counters in `HashMap<WorkStartReason, u64>`. Every successful enqueue hashes a fixed enum, and every snapshot performs one lookup per reason. `WorkStartTally` already exactly represents the public fixed fields. The 00420 session records roughly 2,400 starts.

## Strategy and proof

1. Finish removal of obsolete work-start reasons so the fixed schema is stable.
2. Store and increment `WorkStartTally` directly, with exhaustive matching over live reasons.
3. Preserve snapshot/delta semantics across persistent product sessions.
4. Delete the hash map and lookup closure.
5. Prove byte-identical public traces and identical per-reason/session totals on representative fixtures.
6. Run scheduler, telemetry, library, fixture, formatting, and strict clippy checks.

No fidelity is traded for the representation change.
title: Replace fixed work-start HashMap accounting with fixed fields
